binary it publishes is libgit2, which is licensed under the GNU General Public

In short: the linking exception lets you link the compiled library into any

What is compiled into the published archive:

  xdiff           LGPL-2.1-or-later (deps/xdiff)      in libgit2 COPYING
  SHA-1 collision detection (sha1dc)   MIT            in libgit2 COPYING

PCRE2, the bundled zlib, ntlmclient and the WinHTTP definitions are in the
libgit2 tree but are not built: regular expressions come from the system's
regcomp, zlib from the Apple SDK, and NTLM is turned off. zlib, iconv,
